item.title: [+2] Sensex jumps 1,109 points to 73,033.78 as IT index surges 5.2% on strong quarterly results
item.description:
Nifty rose 1.6% to 22,721.95. The IT gain was its best day since May 2025, led by a large IT firm's September-quarter results. Midcaps rose about 1%. Reverses Monday's 548-point fall.

IT services: tailwind (+2) — IT index up 5.2%

Why it matters: Better-than-feared IT results ease worries about AI pricing pressure and a weak demand cycle; IT is a large index weight and also earns more as the rupee stays weak.

Market gauges: Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: days
